_about: Shaw's Pygmalion (1913), on Heidi White's list. US public domain by publication date. Added in reading-lists batch 9 (2026-10-17): books named by the Omnibus, Callihan, Kern, Pudewa, White and Stanford lists that no shelf held. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): shaw-perfect-wagnerite, shaw-quintessence-ibsenism, shaw-sanity-art, shaw-heartbreak-house, shaw-major-barbara, shaw-back-to-methuselah.

shaw-perfect-wagnerite: The Perfect Wagnerite: A Commentary on the Niblung's Ring
shaw-back-to-methuselah: Back to Methuselah: A Metabiological Pentateuch

shaw-quintessence-ibsenism: The Quintessence of Ibsenism, now completed to the death of Ibsen

shaw-perfect-wagnerite.case: Bloom's Major Critical Essays is the standard trio: The Quintessence of Ibsenism, The Perfect Wagnerite and The Sanity of Art. All three are pre-1931.

shaw-quintessence-ibsenism.evidence: Read title page, contents and 'Preface: 1913'; Trent University copy, not lending.
shaw-quintessence-ibsenism.case: Bloom's Major Critical Essays is the standard trio: The Quintessence of Ibsenism, The Perfect Wagnerite and The Sanity of Art. All three are pre-1931.

shaw-sanity-art.year: 1908 (title page: New York, Benj. R. Tucker, 1908; 'Copyright, 1895')
shaw-sanity-art.evidence: Read title page and preface; University of Toronto copy.
shaw-sanity-art.case: Bloom's Major Critical Essays is the standard trio: The Quintessence of Ibsenism, The Perfect Wagnerite and The Sanity of Art. All three are pre-1931.

shaw-heartbreak-house.case: Bloom lists Heartbreak House (1919). PG text.

shaw-major-barbara.evidence: PG header read; PG 3789 is only the Preface.
shaw-major-barbara.case: Bloom lists Major Barbara (1907). Use PG 3790, the play; PG 3789 is only the preface.
shaw-major-barbara.note: Both are worth taking, since Shaw's prefaces are part of the work.

shaw-back-to-methuselah.case: Bloom lists Back to Methuselah (1921). PG text.
